name: Agent Sandbox hardened runtime class
description: Ensure Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate resources use an approved hardened runtimeClassName to isolate untrusted workloads from the host kernel.
remediation: Set spec.podTemplate.spec.runtimeClassName on the SandboxTemplate to an approved hardened runtime.
test: Check that each Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate defines spec.podTemplate.spec.runtimeClassName and that the value is included in the configured hardened runtime allowlist.
